operations.all_candidate_stages_quiet: all exact stages T3 terminal with hasPendingChildRuns=false; known running/pending false; otherwise NULL
operations.all_native_stages_active_observed: all original per-stage native_active_observed booleans, never task-ID/terminal inference
operations.all_native_stages_complete: all required recorded stages have actual native complete evidence; noncomplete false, missing NULL
operations.copy: exact original value, no grading or conversion
operations.declared_scope_label: only exact declared scope labels in full_scope_labels; never counts/axis wording/filenames
operations.empty_children_only: original explicit empty owned-child set/count, no native/source proof
operations.explicit_bool: only original JSON bool, else NULL
operations.inverse_bool: invert one explicit original boolean; never absence
operations.native_complete_only: all explicitly reported native states complete, else false for a known noncomplete state or NULL if absent
operations.native_stage_statuses: original native status list per original stage, no cumulative usage sum
operations.native_status_only: select actual native projection/Goal status fields only; never T3 or narrative
operations.no_pending_terminal: always NULL: pending=false alone cannot establish terminal/quiet
operations.positive_seconds: positive numeric original elapsed, descriptive only
operations.review_artifact_delivery: original explicit reviewer-artifact delivered bool, separate from T3 task status
operations.review_delivery: exact delivered/partial/missing statuses, scientific grade independent
operations.selected_tasks_final_presence: same exact selection, original explicit output_present for each configured final stage; declared artifact delivery only, no fulfilled scope
operations.selected_tasks_native_active: same exact selection, actual get_goal activation status active for each stage; missing NULL
operations.selected_tasks_native_complete: select exact case/arm/candidate-directory version; actual native terminal receipts complete for each selected stage; missing NULL
operations.selected_tasks_native_statuses: same exact selection, actual original native terminal statuses separately
operations.six_axis_census_only: original declared6/assessed6/unassessed0 AXIS inventory only; no full source/process inference
operations.six_axis_explicit_assessment: all exactly six original per-axis assessment fields explicitly assessed; grade statuses ignored; no FULL_SOURCE inference
operations.t3_terminal_delivery: original structured task status only; no full scientific scope or grade inferred
operations.unstarted_delivery_false: exact explicit unstarted/held status establishes no authorized scientific final delivery; no zero-cost/grade inference
operations.unstarted_review_status: exact explicit unstarted/held status becomes NOT_STARTED, no grade
operations.zero_overrun: reported reviewer overrun == 0 only; no timing substitution
